response.title: Volly, the internal app directory for AI-native teams
response.text:
Volly, the internal app directory for AI-native teams

# Your team just built a tool with AI. Now what? 

Volly securely deploys and shares what your team builds with Claude. One login, one place, no engineer required.

> “I've been asking for a place to host our internal tools for months. The blocker is always security and access. People just share files with nowhere central to find them.”

Director of Product Design Mid-sized SaaS company

## From prototype to company-wide in three steps.

### Upload in seconds

Drop in a static page, a prototype, or a data tool. No deploy config and no engineer required.

### Set who can access it

Choose who sees it: just you, your team, or the whole company. Access uses your existing company login, so there are no new passwords and no public URLs.

### Find it in one directory

Every published tool lives in one shared place. Colleagues find it, use it, and request access, while IT keeps full visibility.

## Built for how your team actually ships.

The parts that make an AI-built tool safe to share.

### Deploy from an AI agent

Ship straight from Claude, Cursor, or Codex over MCP, without opening a browser tab.

### One directory

Every published tool lives in a single searchable home for your team.

### Comments on every release

Discuss a deploy right next to the change that shipped it.

### A README for every app

Docs travel with the tool, written once and searchable by anyone with access.

### Visibility you control

Keep an app to yourself, your team, or the whole company, and change it any time.

### Your existing company login

No new passwords and no public links, just the sign-in your team already trusts.

### Access history

See who opened a tool and when, without pinging anyone to ask.

### Git-based deploys

Connect a repository and ship a new version automatically on every push.

## Built for everyone who ships.

The person who builds it, the lead who owns access, and the team that relies on it each gets exactly what they need.

- ### The builder

You made something useful with Claude, Codex, or Cursor. Volly gets it in front of your team in minutes, without a complex deployment.
- ### The eng lead

You're getting pinged to host random internal tools. Get one place to see everything, control access, and stay out of the ticket queue.
- ### The whole team

A directory of the tools your colleagues built. Searchable, accessible with your work login, no IT ticket required.

## Bring your team's AI-built tools out of hiding.
